description: A warmly nostalgic sitting room corner with English country cottage character. The wall is finished in a textured warm beige plaster, and a small botanical print in a simple frame hangs above the table at picture height. A wooden side table or nightstand in dark polished mahogany or cherry wood with carved drawer fronts and a rich dark finish sits at center, its surface holding a bone china teacup and saucer with a delicate floral pattern, a small green ceramic pot with a live fern, and a warm amber glow emanating from a stained-glass or leaded-glass paneled object whose warm tones — cream, amber, and soft caramel — light up from within and spill warm color onto the table surface below. To the right, a cozy upholstered armchair in warm greige fabric is partially visible, draped with a loose knit throw blanket in natural cream. A multi-pane window behind the chair filters soft afternoon light through linen curtains in warm sand tones, filling the right side of the frame with gentle illumination. The floor is partially visible with a dark wood tone. The overall palette is entirely warm: honey amber, dark mahogany, cream, sage green, and warm beige plaster. The mood is nostalgic, quiet, and profoundly domestic. Camera at seated to standing eye-level using a normal to slightly telephoto lens, with a tight vignette composition centered on the side table surface, the armchair and window providing background depth and soft backlight. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
